registrations.packaging: USP Type I Clear Glass Vial (Box of 10's)

summary: Soluvit N (Fresenius Kabi) is a freeze-dried mixture of water-soluble vitamins added to parenteral nutrition, one vial per day for adults. Philippine registration: glass vials, box of 10.
composition_notes: Contains methyl parahydroxybenzoate 0.5 mg per vial (SmPC).
Source is the Irish SmPC of the same Fresenius Kabi product sold in Ireland as Solivito N; confirm against the Philippine package insert.
dosing_limits: Adults and children 10 kg or more: one vial per day (SmPC 4.2).
kidney_notes: Biotin can interfere with laboratory tests that use biotin-streptavidin technology; the SmPC notes the risk is higher in patients with renal impairment and with higher doses. Tell the laboratory (SmPC 4.4).
guideline_heading: How it fits the ESPEN 2021 kidney nutrition guideline
guideline: ESPEN 2021 Recommendation 23: "Because of increased requirements during KF and critical illness, and large effluent losses during KRT, water-soluble vitamins should be monitored and supplemented. Special attention should be given to vitamin C, folate, and thiamine." Grade of recommendation B – Strong consensus (100% agreement).
bottom_line: The standard way to give water-soluble vitamins in PN; ESPEN asks for monitoring and supplementation of water-soluble vitamins in kidney failure and KRT, with special attention to vitamin C, folate and thiamine. Warn the laboratory about biotin interference.

sources.citation: Fresenius Kabi. (2019). Solivito N powder for concentrate for solution for infusion (PA2059/064/001) [Summary of product characteristics; text revised October 2019]. Health Products Regulatory Authority.
